findings.text: done-when clause 2 requires "a table per lane: runs, median gate share of wall time, and runs with a truncated gate", one median, but the second deliverable bullet at line 48 requires the gate share reported "twice: once over the runs whose every gate duration came from a log, and once over all runs", with "the share of runs that used the fallback" beside each median, and the background-gate runs listed separately; a worker can satisfy the done-when with the single all-runs median — the fallback-undercounted figure the bullet says "would miss exactly the long gates this plan is about"
